title: Add a new APT repository
summary: Add a new software repository to your system's package manager so you can install packages from it.
prerequisites: Know the repository specification (e.g., 'ppa:owner/name' or a full deb URL)

steps.explain: Add the specified repository to the list of sources apt uses to find packages.

placeholders.name: REPOSITORY_SPEC
placeholders.description: The repository to add, e.g. 'ppa:graphics-drivers/ppa' or 'deb http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu focal main'

alternatives.explain: Add the repository and immediately update the package list so new packages are available.

rollback.explain: Remove the repository you just added.

warnings: Only add repositories from trusted sources. Untrusted repositories can compromise your system security.
